caption:
Ambarella stock fell 19.8% on Wednesday after the camera-chip maker forecast next-quarter sales of $70M to $75M, down from $115.2M and about 35% below Wall Street's estimate.
CEO Fermi Wang blamed "the unprecedented rise in memory prices and the scarcity of memory supply": customers who can't get memory for their devices are cancelling or delaying chip orders. Bank of America cut its target to $30 from $70.
